item.title: Livingston County Assessment Forms
item.description: Assessment forms from the County Assessor’s Office were mailed to Livingston County property owners on December 31st. Livingston County Assessor Rich Thieme says there are two options for filing the forms. Fill them out manually and return them, or use the on-line option. item.title: City Adopts Hazard Mitigation Plan
item.description: The City of Chillicothe adopted the Livingston County Multi-Jurisdictional Hazard Mitigation Plan as part of Monday’s City Council meeting. Chillicothe Fire Chief Eric Reeter presented the plan. He says the approval does help the city. Could allow the city to apply for mitigation grant funding. Reeter says the Chillicothe Fire Department is the response team […]

item.title: Chillicothe PD Leadership Earns FBI LEEDA Agency Trilogy Award
item.description: The FBI’s LEEDA Agency Trilogy Award was presented at Monday’s City Council meeting. Chief Police Jon Maples presented the Agency Award to the Command Staff. Supervisor Leadership, Command Leadership, and Executive Leadership components. Chief Maples says not many departments receive the Agency award. Only 4 or 5 agencies in Missouri to earn the Agency Trilogy […]

item.description: Sixty-one calls for service were handled by the Chillicothe Police Department on Monday. item.title: Jail Bookings For Livingston County
item.description: Three jail bookings for Livingston County are reported by the Livingston County Sheriff’s Department. item.title: Storm Water Alley Project Approved
item.description: The bid for Chillicothe’s Storm Water project, located in the alley from Clay to Ann Street, behind KCHI, was awarded to JD Bishop Construction in Chillicothe. item.description: As the Chillicothe Police Facility project nears completion, certain testing is required. One of the required tests is the Emergency Responder Communications.
